Proportion of a gene set among top-ranked SVGs

Source: R/svg_gene_set.R
plot_svg_topn_gene_set.Rd

Calculate and visualise the proportion of genes belonging to a user-defined gene set among the top-ranked spatially variable genes (SVGs) across normalisation methods.

Usage

plot_svg_topn_gene_set(
  svg_norm,
  genes,
  top_n = c(50, 100, 200, 300),
  method_order = NULL,
  method_colors = NULL,
  gene_id = "rownames",
  theme_name = "classic",
  gene_set_name = "Gene set",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  alpha = 1,
  point_size = 2,
  line_width = 1,
  line_type = "solid",
  show_points = TRUE,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  percentage = FALSE
)

Arguments

svg_norm

Named list of SVG results.

genes

Character vector containing genes of interest.

top_n

Numeric vector of top-N SVG thresholds.

method_order

Optional normalisation method order.

method_colors

Optional named vector of method colours.

gene_id

Gene identifier used in SVG results.

theme_name

Plot theme.

gene_set_name

Name of the gene set.

title

Optional plot title.

subtitle

Optional plot subtitle.

alpha

Transparency of points and lines.

point_size

Point size.

line_width

Line width.

line_type

Line type.

show_points

Logical. Display points at each top-N value.

show_legend

Logical. Display the method legend.

percentage

Logical. Display y-axis as percentages.

Value

List containing data and plot.

Details

The gene set may contain housekeeping genes, negative-control genes, marker genes, or any other user-defined gene set.

Examples

data(svg_example)

genes <- head(rownames(svg_example[[1]]), 20)

p <- plot_svg_topn_gene_set(
  svg_norm = svg_example,
  genes = genes,
  top_n = c(10, 20, 50),
  gene_set_name = "Example genes"
)

p$plot
